“我住在那个以一艘和泰坦尼克号一样豪华的船命名的沙海酒吧大楼里。”

segments.body:
And no, you've never heard of it, because it never sank.
别问，你肯定没听说过，因为它从没沉没过。

So if you speak Spanish, you are in luck, my friend.

So if you speak Spanish, you are in luck, my friend.
所以如果你会说西班牙语，那你就走运了，朋友。

segments.body:
And if you don't speak Spanish, I bet this is not the first time that you are filled with regret about the choices you've made in your life.
如果你不会说西班牙语，我敢打赌，这肯定不是你第一次因为自己人生中做出的选择而感到后悔了。
